counting_rule.unit_of_account: parenthesis-depth-0 invocation inside an executable method body
counting_rule.assertion_call: one JUnit/Hamcrest assertion call = one assertion unit
counting_rule.throw_guard: one `throw new X(...)` fail-closed guard = one assertion unit
counting_rule.delegation: one call to a method declared by the same class or a vendored superclass (including `new Helper(...).method(...)`) = one scenario unit, and the target is itself inventoried
counting_rule.vector_loop: a for-each over a field initialised from a literal collection contributes len(unique elements) * (units inside the loop body); the invocations inside the loop body are not counted again
counting_rule.nested_calls: invocations nested inside another invocation's argument list are arguments, not scenarios
counting_rule.setup: allow-listed construction/accessor/plumbing calls contribute zero units
counting_rule.fail_closed: an unclassified depth-0 invocation aborts the extraction rather than being silently skipped
